---
title: Find the few causes behind most defects
description: A Pareto chart ranks causes from the largest down and adds a running share, so the reader sees how few causes explain most of the total.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Two causes explain most defects

These illustrative counts come from a production line. The bars run from the largest cause down; the line at the right adds them up as a share of all defects.

```chart
type: pareto
title: Misalignment and discolouration cause 71 percent of defects
subtitle: Defects per cause, with the running share of the total
data:
  inline:
    - cause: Scratches
      defects: 18
    - cause: Misalignment
      defects: 52
    - cause: Cracks
      defects: 9
    - cause: Discolouration
      defects: 31
    - cause: Other
      defects: 6
encoding: {x: cause, y: defects}
axes:
  y: {label: Defects}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each cause's count, its share and the share of the causes up to it.
